checks: Modern official MCP client discovers six genuine tools and paginates real products through verified upstream TLS
A genuine create_product writes WooCommerce over authenticated TLS and list_products reads the exact SKU/price
list_orders/get_order return the real COD order; update_order_status changes it and the original status is restored
Legacy official session-client behavior interoperates with the same private TLS MCP server
A correct upstream bearer is insufficient without the exact permitted service certificate; the certificate is insufficient without the bearer
